About

Hi, I'm Wai Yee

I turn campaign briefs into artwork people want to keep. My work spans premium and giveaway design, social content, vehicle livery, and in-store collateral — built to hold up from a phone screen to a lorry panel.

I've worked on recurring campaign design for McDonald's Singapore — Happy Meal premiums, seasonal giveaways, social posts, and in-store signage — alongside freelance branding projects like Prime Asia's fleet livery.

I care about the small print: fold lines that actually fold, QR codes that scan, and colours that print true.
